sources.title: amux README (v0.0.21)
sources.locator: Prerequisites; How it works; Features; Controls; Configuration; Platform Support; Operations
sources.finding: TUI that runs parallel coding agents in tmux sessions over git-worktree workspaces; commit and merge actions, lifecycle scripts, port reservations, minisign-verified self-update; MIT; Linux and macOS only.

sources.title: MIT license
sources.finding: MIT License text.

sources.title: go.mod
sources.finding: Go 1.26 module github.com/andyrewlee/amux using Bubble Tea v2.

sources.title: Entry point
sources.finding: Binary accepts only --version; builds exclude Windows; launches the TUI on a real TTY.

sources.title: External orchestration contract
sources.locator: Status of this contract; Session naming grammar; @amux_* tags
sources.finding: amux has no CLI or API; the supported external control surface is the tmux layer with documented session names and @amux_* tags.

sources.title: Configuration reference
sources.locator: assistants map; ui section; environment variables; self-update
sources.finding: ~/.amux/config.json lets users override or add assistants by launch command and interrupt behavior.

sources.title: Storage policies
sources.finding: Local JSON stores under ~/.amux with atomic writes, backups and fail-closed port reservations.

sources.title: Agent registry
sources.finding: Fourteen built-in launch commands: claude, codex, opencode, droid, cursor (agent), pi, omp, antigravity (agy), fx, grok, amp, cline, devin, prime-agent.

sources.title: UI settings
sources.finding: notify_on_done rings a terminal bell when an agent finishes; default off.

sources.title: Activity detection
sources.finding: Detects agent activity from tmux output to drive done badges and the on-done hook.

sources.title: Lifecycle scripts
sources.finding: Runs repo/workspace/project scripts with per-workspace ports, trust gating and bounded transcripts.

sources.title: Self-update
sources.finding: Only outbound call found: GitHub releases/latest check at startup; downloads are minisign-verified.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.finding: Go packages for app, tmux, pty, vterm, data, process and UI.

sources.title: amux docs introduction
sources.finding: Pure TUI with no wrappers; cloud sandbox workspaces described as coming soon; tmux required.

sources.title: Workspaces
sources.finding: Workspaces are git worktrees on their own branch; delete removes directory and branch.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 168 stars, MIT, no homepage, pushed 2026-11-12, not archived; companion repos amux-docs and homebrew-amux.

sources.title: GitHub releases
